learningPolicy.sourceOfTruth: Only base rules and learnedRules with status active affect scoring.
learningPolicy.candidateState: Newly inferred or user-stated rules remain proposed until a human approves them.
learningPolicy.promotionGate: Promoting a learned rule to active is an R3 control-plane change.

R0.note: Read-only analysis or harmless documentation; a human accepts the deliverable.

R1.note: Implement and run scoped checks in the workspace; do not merge or deploy.

R2.note: Guarded-auto only when bounded, reversible, non-protected, and free of unresolved material choices.

R3.note: Investigate and prepare the planning work item, then obtain explicit human approval before implementation/source/control edits.

R4.note: Advice and a human-run plan only; the agent must not execute the restricted action.

always: scope review against the declared file manifest
schema: migration rehearsal on an isolated database
docsOnly: scope review (no policy change hidden in documentation)

rules.statement: Every protected mutation must re-check authentication, role, and record ownership at the server boundary.
validation: Verify unauthenticated, wrong-role, wrong-owner, missing-record, and success cases.

rules.statement: Public registration creates CUSTOMER identities only; public flows never assign a privileged role.
validation: Assert every public registration path resolves to CUSTOMER.

rules.statement: Post-authentication redirects use the centralized role-to-route mapping and must not accept an unsafe caller-controlled destination.
validation: Test each supported role and reject external or malformed destinations.

rules.statement: OTP challenges are bound to purpose, phone, and user when applicable; expire after 5 minutes, throttle resend for 60 seconds, allow at most 5 attempts, and are consumed transactionally for identity changes.
validation: Test replay, wrong purpose, wrong phone/user, expiry, throttling, and concurrent consumption.

rules.statement: Role and permission policy changes require explicit human product/security approval and complete audit evidence.
validation: Verify actor authority, target-role constraints, self-escalation denial, and audit coverage.

rules.statement: Actually granting SUPER_ADMIN, impersonating a user, or elevating a real account is a human-executed action.
validation: The agent stops without issuing a mutation command.

rules.statement: Project draft, publish, schedule, and unpublish behavior is controlled by the project-content workflow, not by ad hoc public-page logic.
validation: Test draft, immediate publish, scheduled publish, and unpublish transitions.

rules.statement: Draft, unpublished, and future-scheduled projects are excluded from public routes, catalogs, availability, metadata, and sitemap output.
validation: Test direct slug access and all discovery surfaces at schedule boundaries.

rules.statement: A project-content or availability mutation revalidates affected public caches, broadcasts the version change when applicable, and records an audit entry.
validation: Verify mutation success remains consistent across cached and live public surfaces.

rules.statement: External project media URLs must use HTTPS; durable binary upload, malware scanning, and lifecycle handling are required before local uploads are production-ready.
validation: Reject non-HTTPS external URLs; do not claim binary-upload safety without storage and scan evidence.

rules.statement: An authenticated customer may link or mutate only CRM records that match the verified identity and may not claim unrelated historical records.
validation: Test mismatched phone/user identities and unrelated lead or booking records.

rules.statement: Customer profile changes affect linked active leads only; phone changes require OTP verification, and email editing stays disabled until a verified workflow exists.
validation: Verify inactive and unrelated CRM records remain unchanged.

rules.statement: Viewing slots are interpreted in Malaysia time, server-validated, and deduplicated; a REQUESTED viewing is not a confirmed appointment.
validation: Test Malaysia date boundaries, duplicates, invalid slots, and state labels.

rules.statement: Lead claim and assignment must use an atomic conditional update, enforce actor scope, and write an audit entry.
validation: Prove two simultaneous claimers cannot both succeed.

rules.statement: Booking status changes follow the declared transition graph and update status history, activity, and audit evidence atomically.
validation: Test every legal and illegal transition, retry, and partial-failure case.

rules.statement: A booking reserves only an available unit, prevents conflicting active reservations, and releases the unit only when no other active booking still owns it.
validation: Race two reservations for one unit and test release with another active booking present.

rules.statement: Reservation expiry defaults to 3 days and letter-of-offer signing to 14 days through settings; expiry is idempotent and records history and activity.
validation: Test configured and default durations, repeated expiry, and already-inactive bookings.

rules.statement: Payment records and booking payment-state transitions require authorization, valid state invariants, idempotency, transaction safety, and audit evidence; verification is a human decision.
validation: Test duplicate submissions, invalid amounts/states, wrong roles, and rollback on failure.

rules.statement: Actually marking a real customer payment as verified, paid, refunded, or reversed is human-executed.
validation: The agent provides a human checklist and performs no real payment mutation.

rules.statement: Customer documents are Restricted data, never model input, and require server authorization, verified content type, malware CLEAN status, durable storage, and access logging.
validation: Reject wrong owner/role, spoofed types, non-CLEAN files, path traversal, and unlogged access.

rules.statement: Document verification, rejection, and waiver require an authorized human decision, a reason where required, an immutable verification log, and synchronized booking activity.
validation: Test closed requests, inactive bookings, missing reasons, repeated actions, and rollback.

rules.statement: Actually approving, verifying, rejecting, or waiving a real customer document is a human-executed decision.
validation: The agent may prepare a review checklist but performs no real document decision.

rules.statement: Every meaningful business mutation writes a sanitized operational audit entry through the central helper; high-volume page views belong in consented analytics instead.
validation: Assert actor, action, entity, outcome, and sanitized metadata for success and relevant failure paths.

rules.statement: Marketing scripts, tracking, and attribution remain disabled until explicit consent and are revoked or suppressed after denial or withdrawal.
validation: Verify providers never load or receive events before consent and stop after revocation.

rules.statement: WhatsApp V1 inbound processing is deterministic, verifies the provider signature on the raw payload, deduplicates provider event IDs, and records sanitized processing outcomes.
validation: Test invalid signatures, replayed events, malformed payloads, unsupported events, and sanitized logs.

rules.statement: Sending or broadcasting real outbound customer messages is human-executed; the agent may design and test with synthetic recipients but may not trigger delivery.
validation: No tool or production provider call is made by the agent.

rules.statement: Project imports are schema-validated, bind preview to the exact payload, preserve omitted existing values, and execute transactionally with rollback evidence.
validation: Test malformed payloads, stale previews, partial failure, retry, and omitted existing fields.

rules.statement: Schema and migration changes use one designated writer, generated SQL review, isolated rehearsal, and recovery evidence; production migration execution is human-controlled.
validation: Test empty and prior-version databases and preserve backup or forward-fix evidence.

rules.statement: Configuration changes document variable names and safe placeholders only, validate required values at startup, and never expose real secret values.
validation: Use placeholders in tests and verify missing or malformed required values fail safely.

rules.statement: Real secrets, credentials, OTP values, session tokens, and production environment files are never read, printed, copied, rotated, or changed by an agent.
validation: The agent stops and does not read or echo the value-bearing file.

rules.statement: Route handlers validate client input with Zod and return the shared okJson/errorJson contract with stable, sanitized errors.
validation: Test invalid JSON/input, stable codes, sanitized failures, and expected success envelopes.

rules.statement: Unauthenticated mutation endpoints require server validation, rate limiting or equivalent abuse control, bot mitigation where appropriate, and minimal responses.
validation: Test malformed, oversized, repeated, automated, and privacy-sensitive requests.

rules.statement: Reports and exports enforce role and ownership scope, use complete aggregates, neutralize spreadsheet injection, minimize PII, and audit exports.
validation: Test role scopes, large datasets, formula-prefixed values, and audit records.

rules.statement: UI changes reuse established primitives, remain responsive, support keyboard and screen-reader use, respect theme and reduced motion, and expose clear loading/error states.
validation: Verify keyboard flow, labels/errors, mobile and desktop layouts, both themes, and reduced motion.

rules.statement: Public indexable pages provide accurate metadata, canonical URLs, robots/sitemap behavior, and structured data without bypassing consent rules.
validation: Verify public visibility rules and validate generated structured data.

rules.statement: Before changing Next.js behavior, read the relevant version-matched guide under node_modules/next/dist/docs and follow its deprecation notices.
validation: Record the exact local guide consulted in change evidence.

rules.statement: Tests derive from acceptance criteria and cover negative paths; an agent never weakens requirements, controls, or assertions merely to obtain a pass.
validation: Map each changed behavior to positive and applicable negative test evidence.

rules.statement: Preserve unrelated tracked and untracked user work; never revert, stash, overwrite, move, or delete outside the declared change set.
validation: Compare initial status, declared ownership, and final manifest.

rules.statement: Agent instructions, SDLC rules, calculator logic, CI, ownership policy, dependency manifests, and framework configuration are protected control-plane changes.
validation: Validate the registry and calculator and test representative risk classes and bypass attempts.

rules.statement: Actually approving or merging a pull request, or pushing to the default or a protected branch, is human-executed; an agent never approves its own work.
validation: Confirm the agent stops before approval, merge, or protected/default-branch push actions.

rules.statement: Destructive or difficult-to-recover operations require explicit human authorization naming exact targets and are not autonomously executed.
validation: The agent stops before any destructive command or mutation.

rules.statement: Production deploys, production migrations, real-data backfills, and direct production data changes are human-executed actions.
validation: The agent limits output to evidence and an approved human-run procedure.

rules.statement: Coding-agent prompts, logs, fixtures, and evidence use synthetic or redacted data only; customer PII, OTPs, documents, credentials, and raw conversations are excluded.
validation: Review model-visible inputs and artifacts for prohibited data classes.

rules.statement: Directly reading, printing, copying, or pasting real customer PII, production records, documents, OTPs, or raw conversations into an agent session is prohibited.
validation: The agent stops before retrieving or exposing restricted data and offers a synthetic or redacted workflow.

escalators.when: The change is cross-cutting or touches more than 15 files.
A change can cause an external side effect.
Money, price, commission, or sellable inventory can change.
The request declares no reliable rollback path.
